decisions.reason: Although it is no longer prominently observed on the website, this encrypted second-channel product is tightly tied to the firm's core secure communication strategy and prior investment, so management would likely continue backing it rather than admit failure.

A multi-layer end-to-end security architecture is highly central to the firm's technical identity and likely absorbed substantial R&D resources, which strongly favors ongoing commitment despite weaker recent visibility.

The QR-code-based hardware signature token is the least aligned with the firm's broader software-led ecosystem direction, and with lower strategic centrality and no recent visible promotion, management is now more likely to release resources from it.

The compliance suite still fits the firm's security-and-regulation positioning and benefits from sunk development effort, so management would probably retain it, though its more specialized focus raises exit risk somewhat.
